Loss report: drone -> forgejo
[lost] pipeline/drone/job/deploy job.environment (Forgejo does not document environment)
[external] pipeline/drone/job/deploy job.environment.approval: configure required reviewers on the environment in repository settings
[emulated] pipeline/drone pipeline.concurrency: concurrency group per run (Forgejo cancels earlier push and pull_request runs while concurrency is unset; the source had no concurrency, so each run gets its own group)
[emulated] pipeline/drone/job/deploy job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the pipeline named no runner)
[emulated] pipeline/drone/job/deploy/step/deploy step.image: uses: docker://<image> with entrypoint and args
[emulated] pipeline/drone/trigger/0 trigger.push: branches: '**' (GHA fires a push without filters for branches and tags; branches are named explicitly to leave tags out or beside a tag filter)
